name: lookup_cloudtrail_events
description: Query CloudTrail management events by time window and optional filters. Uses the free LookupEvents API covering the last 90 days of management events. Useful for reconstructing what an IAM principal did around a GuardDuty finding, verifying expected activity, or tracing a session. Multiple filters are ANDed together.

start_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC start time (e.g. '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z'). Defaults to 24 hours before end_time.

end_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC end time (e.g. '2026-04-01T23:59:59Z'). Defaults to now.

event_name.description: CloudTrail API event name to filter on (e.g. 'DescribeStacks', 'AssumeRole', 'PutObject').

username.description: IAM username, role session name, or 'Root' to filter by caller identity.

resource_type.description: AWS resource type to filter on (e.g. 'AWS::S3::Bucket', 'AWS::IAM::Role', 'AWS::EC2::Instance').

resource_name.description: Resource ARN or name to filter on.

access_key_id.description: Access key ID (AKIA... or ASIA...) used in the API call — useful for tracing a specific credential.

read_only.description: Filter to read-only ('true') or write/mutating ('false') events.

account_id.description: AWS account ID to query. Defaults to the security account where AgentSOAR runs.

region.description: AWS region to query (e.g. 'us-east-1'). Defaults to the Lambda execution region.

max_results.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-50, default 20).

name: get_trail_status
description: Check whether a CloudTrail trail is actively logging and delivering events to S3. Returns the trail health, last delivery time, and any errors. Use this to verify CloudTrail coverage before relying on lookup_cloudtrail_events.

trail_name.description: Trail name or ARN. Defaults to 'management-trail' (the org-wide trail).

account_id.description: AWS account ID where the trail lives. Defaults to the Lambda's account.

region.description: AWS region where the trail is configured. Defaults to the Lambda execution region.

name: list_trails
description: List all CloudTrail trails configured in an AWS account, including whether they are organization-wide, multi-region, and where they deliver logs. Use this to understand CloudTrail coverage before investigating an incident.

account_id.description: AWS account ID to query. Defaults to the Lambda's account.

region.description: AWS region to query. Defaults to the Lambda execution region.
